**Pipeline controller notification**
This repo is configured to use the [pipeline controller](https://docs.ci.openshift.org/how-tos/creating-a-pipeline/). Second-stage tests will be triggered either automatically or after lgtm label is added, depending on the repository configuration. The pipeline controller will automatically detect which contexts are required and will utilize `/test` Prow commands to trigger the second stage.

For optional jobs, comment `/test ?` to see a list of all defined jobs. To trigger manually all jobs from second stage use `/pipeline required` command. 

This repository is configured in: LGTM mode

Skipping CI for Draft Pull Request.
If you want CI signal for your change, please convert it to an actual PR.
You can still manually trigger a test run with `/test all`

## Walkthrough Updated systemd unit query logic in the daemon: `listSystemdUnits` now retrieves systemd unit files instead of active/loaded units, and `writeUnits` extended enable/disable eligibility to include units that exist as systemd unit files on disk. ## Changes |Cohort / File(s)|Summary| |---|---| |**Systemd Unit Query Refactoring**
`pkg/daemon/update.go`|Modified `listSystemdUnits` to query unit files via `ListUnitFilesContext` instead of active units, returning `map[string]systemddbus.UnitFile` rather than `map[string]systemddbus.UnitStatus`. Updated `writeUnits` enable/disable eligibility logic to consider both ignition contents and actual systemd unit file existence on disk.| ## Estimated code review effort 🎯 2 (Simple) | ⏱️ ~10 minutes
🚥 Pre-merge checks | ✅ 10
✅ Passed checks (10 passed) | Check name | Status | Explanation | | :----------------------------------------------: | :------- | :--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | | Docstring Coverage | ✅ Passed | No functions found in the changed files to evaluate docstring coverage. Skipping docstring coverage check. | | Stable And Deterministic Test Names | ✅ Passed | The pull request only modifies non-test source files with no Ginkgo test declarations, making the test naming check not applicable. | | Test Structure And Quality | ✅ Passed | The PR uses standard Go testing with table-driven patterns, not Ginkgo BDD syntax, so Ginkgo-specific quality requirements are not applicable. | | Microshift Test Compatibility | ✅ Passed | PR modifies daemon implementation code in pkg/daemon/update.go without adding any new Ginkgo e2e tests. | | Single Node Openshift (Sno) Test Compatibility | ✅ Passed | PR changes only affect production daemon code in pkg/daemon/update.go with no new Ginkgo e2e tests added. | | Topology-Aware Scheduling Compatibility | ✅ Passed | PR modifies only internal daemon logic for systemd unit file management; does not affect Kubernetes manifests, pod scheduling, affinity rules, or topology-dependent scheduling. | | Ote Binary Stdout Contract | ✅ Passed | The pull request modifies systemd unit listing and writing logic in pkg/daemon/update.go. The two cmd.Stdout = os.Stdout statements execute only during daemon configuration updates, not at process startup or during OTE test initialization, making them compliant with the OTE Binary Stdout Contract. | | Ipv6 And Disconnected Network Test Compatibility | ✅ Passed | This PR modifies production daemon code (pkg/daemon/update.go) without adding any Ginkgo e2e tests, so the IPv6 and disconnected network compatibility check is not applicable. | | Title check | ✅ Passed | The title clearly summarizes the main change: enabling systemd units that have existing files, which directly aligns with the PR's core modification to consider both ignition contents and existing unit files. | | Description Check | ✅ Passed | Check skipped - CodeRabbit’s high-level summary is enabled. |
✏️ Tip: You can configure your own custom pre-merge checks in the settings.
✨ Finishing Touches
🧪 Generate unit tests (beta) - [ ] Create PR with unit tests
